scope: Independent fresh local PBF readback for all135same-city exact-name/explicit-alias objects,complete original node/way/member references,and the Pecs municipality reference. No producer extractor imported or invoked.

notes: The latest URL is mutable; SHA256 identifies this exact snapshot.
MD5 verifies the publisher checksum; SHA256 pins the acquired bytes.
OSM community boundaries are not necessarily official legal boundaries.

freshReadMethod: One new osmium.FileProcessor pass with IdFilter over the union of required IDs;retain typed IDs only. No missing coordinate,way,relation or geometry is invented.

matchingReview.normalization: Unicode NFD/casefold followed by alphanumeric characters;combining diacritics,punctuation and whitespace ignored. No spelling replacement,fuzzy matching,substring,nearest name point or invented alias.

excludedCountryCandidates.scope: Fresh PBF pass covers all retained same-city objects and their dependencies;no claim of a second whole-country name-completeness extraction.

limits: CurrentOSMplace labels are community name evidence,not an official complete urban-neighbourhood inventory.
A street,bus stop,POI,functional area or historicalold_name match does not become current quarter-name/footprint approval.
Fresh city association confirms complete object geometry inside this PBF municipality;it does not certify legal jurisdiction,source-quarter extent or absolute boundary accuracy.
